authors: ML dataset Koblitz47 F6 and enumeration campaign

claims.text: All 16 fixed plan indices have at most one native attempt; censored, failed, unsupported and interrupted cells remain in the denominator.

A completed F6WidePairIndex m4 cell retains a hash-checked bounded signed pair table; any positive PDP witness requires independent group replay. The adapter is geometric four-sum, not general Groebner F6.
A completed enumeration cell retains its counted visited transitions and bounded finite-domain outcome; a budget stop does not certify no decomposition.
An ECDLP scalar label is promoted only after native independent recovery and generator-target group replay.
Each attempted shard retains native verify, report and strict export statuses, a restricted archive and fresh S3 archive and pointer readback receipts; failures remain counted.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Any positive PDP witness or independently recovered ECDLP scalar requires native mathematical replay; this fixed-population pilot makes no detector-sensitivity claim.

decision_rule.statistic: Exact counts by method, twist, generator/key and native status; verified F6 pair domains, enumeration traces, independently replayed scalar labels and S3 custody
decision_rule.text: Account all 16 fixed cells. Promote only verified method and scalar labels. Retain all timeouts, unsupported, partial and construction failures. Durable requires fresh S3 readback/hash match.

stopping_rules.rule: All 16 plan indices0..15, at most one new native attempt each; retain every outcome without replacement.
